tei:div.tei:p: (cha)༄༅// badz+rapañdzaranāthasapariwāreṇanaṃtradharmapālānāṃdhūpapūdzanātsāramārādwidzayas+yadun+dubhiswaranāmabidzahāraṃ//

༄༅// rdo rje gur gyi mgon po 'khor dang bcas pas mtshon pa'i chos srung rnams kyi bsang mchod cho ga bdud las rgyal ba'i rnga sgra zhes bya ba bzhugs// phrin las rnam bzhi gang gang gis// 'dul bar 'gyur ba de de yi// don mdzad bla ma lha lha chen// tha dad min pas srungs srungs shig /legs pa kun gzhi lam gyi mchog /lam mthar phyin la srung ma gtso// de nyid mnyes byed mchod 'bul te// mchod tshul cho ga shes las 'byung*// gang phyir rdo rje nag po che// 'khor dang bcas pa'i bstan srung rnams// dri zhim bsang mchod stob pa'i tshul// bdud las rgyal ba'i rnga chen brdung*// 'di'i bsang mchod la 'jug pas mañdzi sogs kyi khar yi dam gyi zlum gtor gcig de'i mdun du snod gcig tu dbus su gur mgon lcam dral las mgon bcas la smug rtsis byugs pa'i zlum gtor gcig g.yas su zhal gyi gtor ma/ g.yon du dur khrod sogs srung ma spyi la gcig rnams mtheb skyu ci mang gis bskor ba rgyan ldan/ gzhan yang spyan gzigs nyer spyod/ nang mchod/ spos shing sna tshogs kyi dud pa btang ba sogs spyi ltar bsham mo// de nas yo byad rnams a mṛ ta sogs kyis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las āḥlas ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams su/ hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i nye bar spyod pa rnams dang*/ gzhan yang bsang rdzas spyan gzigs mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pas nam mkha'i khams gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ swā hās byin gyis brlab cing spel la/ thog mar spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐ phyogs bcu'i lha yi rdzing ring yongs khyab pa'i// bde chen lhun gyis grub pa'i zhing khams nas// dpal gyi 'byung gnas bla ma lha yi tshogs// spyan 'dren gnas 'dir smon lam dbang gis spyon// rgyal ba rnam par snang chen thugs kyi klong*// rang bzhin gnas dang gru 'dzin ti se gangs// rdo rje'i gdan sa dur khrod gnas brgyad sogs// chos dbyings khyab gdal gar bzhugs gnas rnams nas// bstan srung yongs kyi sde dpon nag po che// gur gyi mgon po lcam dral gdong bzhi ldan// gnod sbyin yab yum pu tra ming sring gsum// dur khrod yab yum dmag zor gshin rje sogs// gsang chen rgyud sde'i srung ma bzhugs so 'tshal// dam tshig g.yab mos gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gyi// thogs pa mi mnga'i mngon shes rdzu 'phrul mthus// rengs par tshur spyon badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ// bzhugs su gsol ba ni/

hūm̐ mchod par 'os pa'i mgron mchog rgya mtsho rnams// sngo bsangs mkha' yi bu mo'i 'gram pa 'dir// rnam par bkod pa so so'i gdan stengs su// gzi brjid nyi ma brgya bzhin lham mer bzhugs// gsal gdab pa ni/ hūm̐ sna tshogs gzugs dang me long phrad pa'i tshe// snang ba'i ngo mtshar ji bzhin steng gi char// bka' srung bran du 'khol byed gdams ngag gi /bka' babs rim brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams dang*// dus gsum bde gshegs yongs kyi gsang ba gsum// rten dang brten pa'i 'khor lor legs shar ba// dpal ldan dgyes pa rdo rje lha dgus mtshon// yi dam rgyud sde'i lha tshogs rnam par bkra// de yi 'og char 'byung po sha za rnams// rgyu mas lus brgyan ral pa mkhar gzings shing*// ro langs thal ba'i 'khri shing g.yo 'dra dang*// gar stabs stong bsgyur rab 'jigs dur khrod dbus// pad+ma'i lte bar nyin byed dbugs bral steng*// zlum po'i stabs su rab brjid nag po che// gri gug khrag gis gtams pa'i ka pā las// spras pa'i phyag gnyis cha ru gaṇ+ḍīs brjid// khros pa'i zhal gdangs mche ba'i gangs ri'i rtser// ljags dmar glog gi rnam 'gyur ci yang ston// dmar zlum spyan gyi me mdag phung po gsum// smin ma'i mtshams sprin stug po'i khrod na g.yo// kham ser ral pa stong pa'i mkhar 'phyo zhing*// mi mgo'i phreng dang rin chen rus pa sbrul// dar gyi lhab lhub stag lpags sham thabs kyis// rnam par brgyan pa'i 'jigs rung gzugs kyi phul// gang gi g.yas g.yon rgyab mdun steng phyogs nas// bya khyi ce spyang mi nag mkha' lding gi /sprul pa'i pho nyas 'jig rten khams nyul ba'i// rjes su ye shes me lces snyegs pa bzhin// g.yon phyogs rgyal ba kun yum ral gcig ma// sngo bsangs bum pa 'dzin ma'i lto ba yis// stong gsum yangs pa'i snod la 'phya ba'i nang*// rab dmar khrag gi rgya mtsho'i dba' rlabs g.yo// de na bong bu gwa zhon 'dod khams dbang*// mthing nag phyag bzhis gri thod mdung rtse gsum// 'dzin cing mi ro khar bcug mche bas bsdams// mi sdug srin mo khros pa'i cha lugs rdzogs// gtso bo'i g.yas phyogs gdong bzhi nag po che// phyag bzhir gcod 'thung 'jigs pa'i mtshon cha can// tshangs skud dur khrod chas kyis brgyan pa gang*// sring bzhi 'jigs ma'i dbus su ro bro brdung*// lcam dral mdun gyi las mkhan gnod sbyin yab// gri gug thod pas lag brel mi lpags gyon// za 'og gos kyis rnam brgyan gnod sbyin yum// reg gcod spu gri klad pa'i thod pa thogs// srog bdag pu tra ral gri mkha' la 'phyar// klad khrag 'thung zhing dar nag 'jol ber gsol// bdud rje bha tra stag gi slog pa can// dom shing 'phyar zhing mi snying dmar po 'drad// srin mo kha 'bar khrag gi mig gsum g.yo// spu gri bskor zhing rgyu zhags 'dren ma ste// kun kyang srod kyi mun ltar gnag pa'i lus// mi mgo'i phreng dang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan// gzhan yang skyes pa zhub can dge slong dang*// sngags pa phur thogs bud med nag mo ste// ru 'dren sde bzhi sprul pa'i pho nya yi// dmag tshogs bgrang du med pa dgra la 'gyed// slar yang pad+ma nyi zlar dur khrod bdag

/thabs shes keng rus 'jigs pa'i phyag zung gis// thod dbyug 'phyar zhing ka pā lar khrag 'thung*// gar gyi stabs mdzad rin chen rgyan gyis bklubs// rgyal ba kun yum dmag zor re wa tī// re lde'i gos dang khram shing nad rkyal sogs// srin mo'i chas ldan be con thod khrag 'chang*// dre'u rtar zhon nas rlung nag 'tshubs mar rtse// gshin rje'i gshed po'i bka' sdod chos kyi rgyal// ma he nag po'i gdong gi mig gsum bgrad// dbyig pa dang ni zhags pas phyag zung mtshan// khyu mchog rgyab tu dur khrod rgyan gyis brgyan// mgon po phyag bzhi phyag drug ngal bsos po// stag zhon trak+shad gnod sbyin lcam dral sogs// dregs byed bstan srung rgya mtsho'i sde tshogs rnams// lho sprin phung po 'khrigs ltar bzhugs par gyur// bsang mchod stob pa ni/ oṃ yon tan che mchog bla ma dkon mchog gsum// mnyam pa'i skyabs chen srid na mchis min pa'i// bden pa mchog des mchod pa'i yo byad rnams// mchod yul yongs kyi spyan lam mchis gyur cig /hūm̐ bstan srung 'khor bcas dgyes pa'i mthun rdzas su// chu gtsang rak+ta'i mchod yon rgya mtshor bskyil// sna tshogs 'dab stong dbang lnga'i me tog bkra// dri zhim tshil chen spos kyi chu 'dzin dkrigs// nyi zla nor bu zhun chen sgron me 'bar// dri zhim spos chu mkhris pa'i dri chab mtsho// bza' bca'i zhal zas dmar nag ri bo brtsegs// rnga dung rkang chen rol mo 'brug tu ldir// yid 'phrog dbyar gyi dpal mo'i dus ston du// legs par bstar ba'i dri zhim rkang 'thung gi /lo 'dab me tog g.yo ba'i lding khang na// yid 'ong grib bsil 'jo ba sna tshogs dang*// tsan+dan dkar dmar spos kyi bye brag bcas// mtshun zar bsregs pa'i dud sprin 'o ma'i mdangs// gang la reg pas nyes pa kun sbyong zhing*// 'dod yon gya nom 'jo ba'i bsang mchod dang*// nor bu'i ka ba grangs med rab bteg pa'i// gzhal med khang brtsegs nor bu'i 'od stong can// drwa ba dril chung 'thab pa'i sgra brnyan brdung*// 'phan gdugs bla re'i gzha' tshon bkra ba dang*// ngo bo gya nom bde ba chen po'i dngos// rnam pa mtshon cha gzings pa'i gur khang du// bam chen keng rus las grub drag po'i gnas// dur khrod 'byung po'i gad rgyangs sgrogs pa dang*// mdzes byed rin chen rgyan dang dar gyi gos// dur khrod dpa' bo'i rgyan cha ji snyed dang*// rdo rje gri gug thod pa gaṇ+ḍī dang*// ral gri mdung dang mtshon cha go cha'i rigs// 'dod 'jo nor bu'i rnam pa sna tshogs dang*// shis pa'i mtshan brgyad mi dbang rin chen bdun// mu tig g.yu shel byi ru gser dngul ja// 'gro ba'i nyer 'tsho 'bras gro nas sran 'bru// dri bzhon shugs ldan rta dang bong bu dre'u// rdo rje'i rwa rtse rno ba'i g.yag lug ra// mkha' lding mon pa bya khyi ce spyang sogs// g.yab dar mda' dar phye mar ti se'i spun// 'dod dgur byin brlabs gtor ma'i ri bo bstar// mkha' 'gro'i chu bya grangs med rnam rtsen zhing*// dngos grub chu klung 'bab 'jug bdud rtsi yi// rgya mtsho che sogs bsang mchod dam pa 'di// dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang nas bdag cag gi

/'dren pa mchog gi bar du legs byon pa'i// bka' babs bla ma dgyes pa rdo rje sogs// yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul// rdo rje nag po chen po gur mgon dang*// yum chen ral gcig 'dod khams dbang phyug ma// stobs 'phrog dbang po sring bzhi 'khor du bcas// gnod sbyin yab yum pu tra ming sring sogs// dur khrod bdag dang dmag zor chos kyi rgyal// phyag bzhi phyag drug mgon po rnam thos sras// stag zhon trak+shad beg rtse zhang blon sogs// 'khor dang bcas pa'i srung ma'i tshogs la 'bul// gzhan yang so so'i mtshan gyi rgyud mangs dag /ngag gi sor mos bskul bar ma nus pa'i// bka' dang zab gter bstan skyong srung ma'i tshogs// kun la 'bul lo mchod do dgyes par rol// gtor ma 'bul ba ni thog mar yi dam la/ oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka he badz+ra sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta sogs gsum gyis phul/ chos skyong rnams la/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ e ka dza ṭ+yai/ ma hā kā li de byai/ ma hā kā la tsa turmu khā ya/ sarba karma nā the bh+yaḥsarba dharma pā le bh+yaḥs pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta sogs gsum gyis phul/ gtor ma med pa'i tshe gtor sngags 'don mi dgos/ bstod pa ni/ hūm̐ chos dbyings zhi ba'i rang bzhin 'pho min yang*// thabs mkhas khro bo'i sgyu 'phrul bgrang yas kyis// bstan pa srung dang bstan dgra tshar gcod pa'i// rdo rje chos skyong rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// mnga' gsol ni/ hūm̐ rgyal bas rdo rje gur gyi rgyud gsung tshe// ston mchog gsang ba gsum las sprul pa'i gar// gri gug thod pas lag brel nag po che// sa bcu'i dbang phyug chen por mnga' gsol lo// rdo rje theg pa'i gsang mdzod ma lus pa// bshad sgrub dri med dga' ston rab 'gyed cing*// byin rlabs ngad pa ma yal rgyas mdzad pa// bstan srung yongs kyi sde dpon mnga' gsol lo// las mkhan shan pa'i 'khor tshogs grangs med dbus// bstan dgra da ltar mi sgrol 'di ci zhes// 'jigs rung nga ros sa gsum g.yo ba khyod// dam nyams kun gyi gshed mar mnga' gsol lo// 'khor 'das dregs pa yongs kyis zhabs btud kyang*// dam tshig can dang rtag par mnyam 'grogs nas// bsam don sgrub cing dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa// rnal 'byor bdag gi dgra lhar mnga' gsol lo// gangs can spyi dang bye brag yul gru 'dir// sangs rgyas bstan pa de 'dzin 'dus sder bcas// 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i srung mar mnga' gsol lo// chos dang dge 'dun sbyin bdag dar bar mdzod// grangs med mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo dpal lha mo// 'dod khams dbang phyug bstan pa'i bya ra ma// bdag gi ma sring mchog tu mnga' gsol gyi// brtse gdung byams pas skyong ba ma g.yel cig

/rnam bzhi'i phrin las brtsams pa gang dang gang*// lhun gyis 'grub byed gnyan mgon gdong bzhi pa// rnal 'byor srung ma'i mchog tu mnga' gsol gyi// rnam dkar phrin las phyogs bral rgyas par mdzod// dam nyams dgra bgegs yongs kyi stobs dang srog /'phrog byed las mkhan srung ma'i sde tshogs rnams// rnal 'byor bdag gi dgra lhar mnga' gsol gyi// dgra dpung choms la bgegs dpung brlag par mdzod// cung zad nyung bar 'dod na mnga' gsol ma byas kyang chog go /nyams chag bshags pa ni/ thugs rje che dgongs bdag cag rgyu sbyor rnams// bag med dbang gyur srung ma'i dus gtor chag /tshul bzhin ma bsten dam bcas dral ba sogs// nyes tshogs ma lus bsang gi mchod pas bshags// phrin las gsol ba ni/ kye rgyal dang rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob brtse ba che// kun dga' bzang sogs bla ma'i mchog rnams kyis// bsgos pa'i 'phrin yig snying la rnam bkod de// spyi bor rdo rje'i rgya yis btab don bzhin// nyi ma'i gnyen dang dgongs pa gcig nyid du// chos kun 'doms pa'i rgyal po sa skya pa'i// bstan pa'i bshad sgrub snyan pos gangs ri'i ljongs// yongs su khyab par rtag tu rgyas par mdzod// rgyal ba kun bzang bstan pa'i rjes sgrub pa'i// khrims ldan sbrang rtsi 'dzin pa grangs med kyis// 'dzam gling pad+ma'i 'dab yangs thams cad dang*// ljongs 'di'i 'dab ma'i khur du lci bar mdzod// 'jig rten kun du mi nad phyugs nad sogs// 'thab rtsod dus kyi thun gsum zad mtha' ru// bde 'byor nyi ma'i 'od brgya shar ba la// 'gro 'di'i longs su spyod pa'i skal bzang mdzod// bstan srung dbang po rnams kyi ye shes spyan// 'dzums pa med par srung ba'i rwa ba na// bdag cag rgyu sbyor 'khor dang bcas gnas shing*// bar chad mi mthun phyogs las rgyal bar mdzod// tshe srog yongs 'du'i ljon shing brtan pa las// bsod nams 'byor pa'i lo 'dab rgyas pa'i khrod// lung rtogs yon tan 'bras bu g.yur za bas// ris bral 'gro ba'i re skong mchog tu mdzod// yi 'phrog las kyi dam pas sa gsum gyi// stobs 'byor che ba'i skye dgu'i brtan pa dag

/rtse dga' ro la rgyug pa'i blo bzhin du// yongs su dbang byas rtse gcig 'dun par mdzod// mthu stobs sha za'i mdung rnon thogs pa'i lhas// dgra bgegs mi mthun phyogs kyi lha min dpung*// mngon par bcom ste zung 'jug phyag rgya che'i// dngos grub lha yi rgyal srid zin par mdzod// de thob bar gyi skye bar zlos pa'i gar// dal ba 'byor pa'i rten ldan bla ma lhas// rjes su nyer bzung lam gyi gegs zhi ba'i// cho ga dam can srung ma rnams kyis sgrubs// gshegs su gsol ba ni/ cho ga gzhan dang 'brel ba'i tshe mi dgos shing*/ de lta min na/ kye skye med dbyings las dag pa ye shes kyi// skye ba dam pa'i mgron du bos pa rnams// skye ba'i phreng bar 'bral med 'grogs bzhin du// skye med dbyings su gshegs pa'i tshul yang ston// shis brjod ni/ oṃ bla ma yi dam srung ma'i tshogs rnams kyis// byin rlabs dngos grub 'dzad pa med stsol zhing*// 'dod pa'i phrin las ma lus lhun grub pa'i// bkra shis dam pas ding 'dir bde legs shog /ces dang bkra shis bsngo ba gang shes brjod do// smras pa/ bsam kun 'grub pa'i phrin las can// bstan srung nor bu'i mchog yod bzhin// mthong chos dpal 'byung kostu bhar// re ba bcings pa'i skye bo dman// gang phyir dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs// dgyes skyed bsang gi mchod sprin 'dir// bgyis pa'i legs byas stobs bcu pa'i// bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas phyir bsngo// zhes rdo rje gur gyi mgon po 'khor dang bcas pas mtshon pa'i srung ma rnams kyi/ bsang mchod cho ga bdud las rgyal ba'i rnga sgra zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rang gi nye bar gnas pa kun dga' bsam gtan gyis sngar nas bskul ba'i khar/ nye char sa dkar dbu mdzad rdo rje 'dzin pa sangs rgyas dpal ldan pa'i gsung gis bskul ngor/ rgyal ba gnyis pa rje btsun e waṃ pa chen po'i ring lugs kyi rjes su slob pa'i 'dun pa ma bskyud tsam gyi ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas/

dkar po'i gnam lo gsar tshes kyi dmar phyogs mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus tshes bzang por grub par bgyis pa bi dza yan+tu// // ༄༅// gang gi thugs rje'i shing rta la brten nas// 'khor 'das dpal 'byor skyes su 'dren mdzad pas// bla ma mgon po dbyer med phyag bgyis nas// de yi bsang mchod 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs 'dri// 'di'i bsang mchod bya bar 'dod pas/ nyer spyod/ gtor ma/ mda' dar/ phye mar/ shing rtsi sna tshogs kyi dud pa btang ba sogs spyi ltar byas la/ bsang mchod gzhan dang 'brel na mi dgos kyang ma 'brel na skyabs 'gro sems bskyed gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar bya/ spyan 'dren pa ni/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas dur khrod bsil ba tshal nas mgon po mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa spyan drangs par bsams la/ hūm̐ shar lho bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod che// tsan+dan rkang 'thung gis mtshan bsti gnas nas// mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu 'khor dang bcas// spyan 'dren mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// gsal gdab pa ni/ hūm̐ mdun gyi mkha' dkyil sna tshogs pad+ma dang*// nyin byed tshogs bdag gdan la mnyam bzhengs pa'i// sems can re skong mgon po yid bzhin nor// 'char ka'i dmar mdangs kyis mdzes ston zla bzhin// rab dkar dmar 'od chags pa'i khro 'dzum zhal// spyan gsum smin ma'i gur gum nags su g.yo// phyag drug gri gug nor bu cang te'u 'khrol// bum thod rtse gsum dbang gi lcags kyu bsnams// lhab lhub dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis bklubs// ye shes me klong bzhugs pa'i spyi bo ru// dgos 'dod 'byung gnas bla ma rdo rje 'chang*// thugs kar khams gsum dbang sdud mkha' 'gro ma// byi ru ltar dmar lcags kyu thod pa can// smin ma rab 'khyog spyan gsum mkha' la blta// sna tshogs rgyan 'chang gar gyi stabs su bzhugs// 'khor du ye shes 'jig rten mkha' 'gro'i rigs// ngal gsos po dang rmugs 'dzin dbang po sogs// nor lha'i tshogs kyis kun nas bskor bar gyur// bsang mchod stob pa ni/

oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rgyal ba'i gsang gsum yi ge'i byin rlabs dang*// rgyal ba'i myu gu'i sems mchog bskyed pa'i mthus// rgyal ba kun dngos lha mchog mchod pa'i rdzas// rgyal ba'i zhing kun khyab par rgyas gyur cig /mchod yon rgya mtsho sna tshogs 'dab stong bzhad// dri zhim spos gtul sgron me'i phreng ba bstar// dri chab rdzing 'khyil zhal zas gtor ma'i ri// rnga dung rol mo'i sgra dbyangs zhing khams bkang*// rin chen bdun dang 'dod yon gya nom lnga// glang chen rta mchog g.yag lug 'dod 'jo'i ba// gser dngul ja dar gos dang 'bru yi rigs// dkar gsum mngar gsum phye mar bdud rtsi'i mtsho// lo 'dab me tog 'bras bus dud pa'i shing*// dri zhim bsregs pa dud pa'i sprin dkar gyis// zhing khams yongs khyab 'dod yon lnga 'jo zhing*// nyes tshogs sbyang ba'i bsang mchod rgya chen 'di// bla ma mgon po nor bdag mkha' 'gro'i tshogs// 'khor dang bcas la 'bul gyis dgyes par rol// bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor bcas kyi// nyams grib nyes ltung ma lus sbyong du gsol// 'phags pa phyag na pad+mas mtshan pa'i lha// thugs rje'i dbang gis khro bo'i skur sprul nas// mtha' yas lus can re ba yongs skong ba'i// myur mdzad yid bzhin nor bu khyod la bstod// phrin las zhu ba ni/ chos kun zas gtsang sras dang bzhed gcig tu// yang dag smra ba'i rgyal po kun bzang gi /lung rtogs chos kyi nyi ma srid pa 'di'i// phan bde'i 'dab stong gnyen du 'bar bar mdzod// bdag cag sbyin bdag 'khor dang bcas pa yi// phyi dang nang gi bar chad mi mthun phyogs// snang bas mun pa ji bzhin rab bcil te// rtag tu mi 'byung srung ba'i gur khyim mdzod// bsod nams gser gyi sa gzhi yangs pa'i dbus// sde bzhi'i 'byor ba phun tshogs chu gter 'khyil// tshe srog lhun po mi shigs phrag pa nas// yon tan nyi zla'i 'od stong gsal bar mdzod// stobs 'byor yon tan che ldan 'gro ba rnams// 'dod lhas drangs pa'i chags ldan yid bzhin du// rang dbang rtse gcig 'dun cing mi mthun phyogs// tshar gcod las kyi dngos grub 'grub par mdzod// dgyes pa'i 'dzum zer dar dkar g.yab mo yis// srid zhi'i dpal 'byor phywa g.yang ma lus pa// 'di na yongs 'du shis pa'i dag byed gter// rlabs phreng stong gis mdzes par sgrubs shig kye// ces mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i bsang mchod cho ga 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs zhes bya ba 'di ni/

dge slong kun dga' mchog ldan gyis bskul ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis sa dkar bsam 'grub gling du bris pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig /maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅// dpal dur khrod bdag po'i bsang mchod yi ge sprin gyi bzhad sgra zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// dpal ldan bla ma sam+ba raḥ// tha dad min la phyag bgyis nas// de yi bka' stod yab yum gyi// bsang mchod sprin gyi bzhad sgra 'byin// 'dir dpal dur khrod bdag po'i bsang mchod bya bas/ mchod gtor ci 'byor dang shing rtsi sna tshogs kyi dud pa btang la/ ngag tu/ hūm̐ rang bzhin gnas dang au ḍ+yān sogs// gar bzhugs gnas nas dur khrod bdag /bla ma lha dang mkha' 'gror bcas// gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// mdun gyi mkha' dbyings dwangs pa'i gzhir// dngos brgyud slob dpon bde ba'i mchog /yi dam rgyal ba sras dang bcas// sprin ltar gtibs pa'i 'og rol du// chu skyes nyi zlar dur khrod bdag /yab yum keng rus 'jigs pa'i gzugs// phyag gnyis thod dbyug ka pā la// khrag gis rab gtams thugs kar bsnams// sna tshogs rin chen dar gyis bklubs// gar stabs me dpung klong na bzhengs// ye shes 'jig rten mkha' 'gro yi// 'khor bcas gdan la brtan par bzhugs// oṃ bla ma lhag pa'i lha srung rnams// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i gter grub pa'i// bden pa gang gis mchod rdzas rnams// mi zad rgya mtsho'i sprin du gyur// bstan srung dgyes pa'i mthun rdzas su// nye bar spyod pa tshar du dngar// phye mar gtor ma ri bo mnyam// ja bzang 'o zho bdud rtsi'i mtsho// lo 'dab gzhon nu'i rnga yab can// dbyar skyes rkang 'thung bzang dgu dang*// tsan+dan spos sbyar dud pa'i sprin// gtsang byed dpal gyi 'byung gnas dang*// thod pa'i khang brtsegs mtshan nyid rdzogs// sna tshogs na bza'i gzha' ris bkra// rin chen rgyan drug phyi nang rten// 'dod 'jo nor bu shis pa'i rdzas// rin po che lnga 'bru yi rigs// go cha mtshon cha rta drel gnag

/'dab chags sder chags ris su rtse// lha mi'i dpal 'byor ji snyed dag /dus gsum rnam 'dren yongs kyi dngos// 'gro ba smin mdzad bla ma'i tshogs// dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom pa sogs// rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul// 'dren pa'i chos skyong rnal 'byor pa'i// ci 'dod phrin las sgrub myur ba'i// dur khrod sha za yongs kyi gtso// mgon po yab yum dag la 'bul// gang gi bka' sdod las byed pa// dgra bo'i dbugs len bye ba dang*// ye shes 'jig rten sha za'i rigs// bgrang yas mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul// he ru ka dpal yab yum dang*// pad+ma badz+ra sa skya pa// kun bzang yab sras bka' lung gis// bsgos pa g.yar dam bcas don ltar// thub bstan spyi dang bye brag tu// tshe gcig phyag rgya chen po'i grong*// bgrod byed rdo rje'i theg pa yi// bshad sgrub phyogs bcur rgyas pa dang*// rje btsun brtse chen e waṃ pa'i// lugs mchog dri med de 'dzin bcas// yul gru 'dis mtshon 'dzam bu'i gling*// kun du dar zhing rgyas par mdzod// bdag cag rgyu sbyor mi nor bcas// gzhi byes srung skyob mi g.yel zhing*// sdang dgra chom rkun bcing ba dang*// bar chad 'jigs pa med par mdzod// bsod nams ring 'tsho dpal 'byor dang*// thos bsam sgrub pa'i yon tan rnams// dbyar mtsho che ltar rgyas pa dang*// mthar thug rdo rje 'chang sar sbyor// gang brtsams thog mar gegs med cing*// bar du bsgrub pa tshogs med 'grub// tha mar bsam dgu legs grub pa'i// bkra shis nyi ma brgya 'bar mdzod// ces dpal dur khrod bdag po'i bsang mchod yi ge sprin gya bzhad sgra zhes bya ba ni 'di ni/ dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa ye shes dpal ldan pa'i gsung gis bskul ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis dkar po'i dbo zla bar rgyal phur 'dzom pa'i nyin grub par bgyis pa/ maṅga laṃ//

// ༄༅// dpal ldan lha mo dmag zor ma 'khor dang bcas pa'i bsang mchod kyi cho ga sprin gyi rnga chen zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// bde chen snying po yongs 'dzin thar pa'i grong*// yan lag bdun ldan gar gyis rnam rtsen pa// bla ma dus dgra'i dbang por phyag bgyis nas// bka' srung drag mo'i bsang mchod cho ga brtsam/ de la 'dir dpal ldan lha mo dmag zor ma la bsang mchod 'bul ba dag gis mchod gtong bsang rdzas ci 'byor pa bshams la/ thog mar spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐ dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum gcig dbyangs can ma// gdug pa 'dul phyir 'jigs rung skur ston ma// dmag zor rgyal mo 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// dam tshig dbang gis spyan 'dren 'dir gshegs shig /bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐ mdun phyogs nam mkha'i me long dwangs pa'i ngos// dngos brgyud bla ma gshin rje'i gshed dpal sogs// sprin ltar gtibs pa'i g.yar lam ga la bar// dmag zor rgyal mo 'khor bcas brtan par bzhugs// mchod rdzas spel ba ni/ oṃ bde gshegs kun gyi thugs rje smon lam dang*// bdag sogs byang chub sems bskyed stobs dag gis// ye shes dag pa'i rang gzugs mchod pa'i sprin// mu med nam mkhar khyab par rgyas gyur cig /gsal gdab pa ni/ hūm̐ kham nag me rlung rab tu 'tshub ma'i dbus// zhing chen lhu dum 'phyo ba khrag mtsho'i klong*// rus pa'i rgyal po'i sga dang zhing lpags stan// dug sbrul srab rmed kyis brgyan drel rta'i steng*// in+d+ra nī la'i 'khri shing g.yo ba la// dus mtha'i zhugs kyis 'khyud 'dra re wa ti// bstan dgra'i klad pa 'gems pa'i be con dang*// gdug pa'i snying khrag gtams pa'i nal thod 'dzin// lto 'phye gdong lnga'i rgyal pos rang gi gnas// rnam par 'phrul pa rna cha'i zol gyis bsgribs// bdud kyi khram shing rked gzir bam chen zas// zhal du bstabs pa rno dkar mche bas bsdam// srid pa'i 'dren byed zung gis brgyan pa'i sku// re lde nag po'i gos kyis stod g.yogs dang*// mi lpags rlon pa'i gos sogs dur khrod kyi// chas brgyad rnam par brgyan pa'i 'jigs gzugs ma// 'khor du rgyu mas lus brgyan bdud kyi bu// nal bu'i thod pas blangs pa'i khrag dron gyi// btung bas myos pa'i lang ling gar byed cing*// sna tshogs mtshon char 'bebs pa bye ba dang*// lha mo'i gsang gsum yon tan phrin las las// ye shes srid pa'i sgyu 'phrul ci dang cis// zhi rgyas dbang gi phrin las sgrub byed pa'i// ma mo mkha' 'gro bgrang du med mas bskor// las su sangs rgyas bstan pa srung byed cing*// rnal 'byor 'dod pa'i phrin las yongs sgrub pa'i// 'dod khams dbang phyug dpal ldan dmag zor ma// 'khor bcas dgyes pa'i bsang mchod 'bul ba ni// dngos su 'byor dang yid kyi bang mdzod gsum// cig car phye ba'i mchod yon me tog spos// mar me dri chab zhal zas rol mo'i sgra// dam rdzas gtor ma lhun po'i spor mnyam dang*// gzugs mchog 'gros mdzes rta drel g.yag lug ra// stag gzig dom dred sder chags 'dab ldan tshogs// sa gzhi ri gling chu gter bcas pa yi// rten dang brten pa'i 'jig rten bye ba phrag

/lha mi'i dpal gyis gtams pa'i mchod pa dang*// mngon 'dod mi zad 'byung ba lha bsang gi /dri zhim kun du stob pa'i bsang mchod 'bul// bdag sogs nyes ltung ma lus sbyong du gsol// phrin las zhu ba ni/ nyi ma'i gnyen dang rgyal tshab kun dga' bzang*// zung gi lugs mchog 'od stong 'bar ba yis// legs phye theg gsum 'chang gi 'dab stong pas// phyogs bral nor 'dzin dga' tshal mdzes par mdzod// gang 'tsham phrin las dar bab mdza' na mos// stobs 'byor rigs kyis khengs pa'i 'dod ldan yid// rang dbang phrogs nas dge bcu'i dga' ston la// ci dgar rtsen pa'i phrin las rgya chen sgrubs// bdag cag yon sbyor 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// rtag tu mkhyen brtse nus pas bsrungs pa'i khongs// nad med ring du 'tsho sogs mtho ris kyi// yon tan bdun ldan skal ba mchog la sbyor// tshul 'dir 'bad pa'i dge bas yang srid kun// bla ma lha dang bka' srung mi 'bral bar// zab yangs dam pa'i chos la dbang 'byor zhing*// bstan dang 'gro ba'i gsos sman mchog gyur cig /ces dpal ldan lha mo dmag zor ma 'khor dang bcas pa'i bsang mchod kyi cho ga /sprin gyi rnga chen zhes bya ba 'di ni blo gros rnam gsal shākya bzang pos bskul ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas/ rab byung 'dod pa'i 'dzin byed ces pa gsar tshes kyi gnam lo'i mchu zla ba'i mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus tshes dge bar sa dkar bsam 'grub gling du sbyar ba bkra shis par gyur cig/ // ༄༅// dpal ldan lha mo sngags srung drag mo'i bsang dang mnga' gsol bzhugs// ༄༅// na mo gu ra we/ dpal ldan lha mo sngags srung drag mo'i bsang dang mnga' gsol byed par 'dod na/ bsang gi bdag mdun gnyis sngon du song tshar ba'i rjes la/ gtor ma yod na gong 'dir gtor bsngo byed/ med na phye mar rtsi shing sogs kyi dud pa byas la/ mdun gyi nam mkhar lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa gsal bar dmigs la/

'di skad do/ hūm̐ bh+yo/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi bka' srung ma// 'dod pa'i khams kun dbang gi mnga' sgyur ma// ri rab rtse mo sum rtsen lha yi yul// yongs 'dus shing drung mu le mthing gi mtsho// rin chen lnga ldan thod pa'i sku mkhar nas// ma gcig lha mo dpon g.yog 'khor dang bcas// 'dir gshegs bsang dang mnga' gsol mchod pa bzhes// phyi star gangs kyi lha mo dbyangs can ma// nang ltar dpal ldan lha mo dud sol ma// gsang bar 'khor 'das dbang sgyur dregs pa mo// yang gsang chos sku 'phags bzhi bskyed pa'i yum// tshe rabs gtan gyi skabs su mnga' gsol lo// ngan song 'khor ba'i 'jigs las bskyab par mdzod// dgyes pa rdo rje'i rigs mchog bdag med ma// rta mgrin yum chen pad+ma gzi ldan ma// gshin rje gshed kyi yum chen ro langs ma// rab 'byams dkyil 'khor kun gyi gtso mo ste// bdag gi yi dam mchog tu mnga' gsol lo// khyod kyis bir+wa pa la dbang bskur nas// sa drug rtogs bskyed nyi zla gteng par gzung*// de bzhin bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs// spyan ras gzigs kyi tshems kyi rtse nas sprul// phyag na rdo rje'i spyan gyi dbus nas sprul// rdo rje gur gyi phyogs bzhi'i sgo bzhi srung*// rang byung mchod rten brgyad kyi srung ma mdzad// sa brgyad la gnas sems ma thugs rje can// bdag gi lam sna 'dren par mnga' gsol lo// byang chub lam la bar chad med par mdzod// dbang phyug sras mo dkar mo dung skyong ma// lho phyogs gshin rje'i bu mo 'jigs gzugs can// bdud kyi bu mo nag mo re ba tī// ngo bo gcig la rnam pa dpon g.yog tshul// nam zla dus bzhi'i skye 'gro khram la 'debs// bdag gi kag bzlog chen mo mnga' gsol lo// khram phyis shwa gtor dal yams rkyen kha bzlog /rgyud sde rnam bzhi sde snod gsum gyi chos// 'chad nyan bsgom pa su yis byed pa rnams// bu bzhin skyong zhing de yi pho nyar byed// de las 'gal na rang srog me 'bar nas// dmyal bar song zhes rgyal ba'i spyan snga ru// dam bca' tha tshig srung ma'i dam can ma// bdag gi bka' srung mchog tu mnga' gsol lo// rtag tu srung skyob mel tshe ma g.yel cig

/dus ngan mi rnams log par spyod pa'i tshe// lha mo dpon g.yog khros pa'i kha rlangs las// mi nad phyugs nad sprin sngon dmar nag 'khrigs// de phyir nad kyi bdag mo zhes su grags// bdag gi las mkhan mchog tu mnga' gsol lo// zhing bcu tshang ba'i bstan dgra dam nyams la// bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad kyi sa bon thob// lha mo khyod la mchod bstod sngags bzlas na// nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi zhi bar mdzod// de phyir bdud rtsi sman gyi rgyal mor grags// bdag gi sman pa mchog tu mnga' gsol lo// bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod mi nor la// zhal nas bdud rtsi'i char pa'i rgyun phob la// nad gdon dal yams rims nad zhi bar mdzod// lha mo'i phrin las bzhi yi rnam 'phrul las// phyi ltar rgyu skar lha mo nyi shu brgyad// nang ltar dbang phyug nyer brgyad dkyil 'khor skyong*// gsang ba nyer bzhi'i yul gyi gnas bdag mo// 'dir gshegs mnga' gsol mchod gtor 'di bzhes la// shar gyi ma bdun ma ltar byams mdzod la// nad gdon bar chad tshogs rnams zhi bar mdzod// lho yi sring bdun sring ltar gdung sems kyis// tshe dang bsod nams dbang thang rgyas par mdzod// nub kyi ma bdun mdza' ltar brtse sems kyis// yid la 'dod pa'i dngos grub dbang 'dus mdzod// byang gi bran bdun bran ltar bka' nyon la// ci ltar bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod// ri rtse brag rong chu mdo shing drung mtsho// gangs gnyan gnas phran dur khrod thams cad du// sprul pa'i 'jig rten ma mo rlung ltar 'tshubs// 'dir gshegs mnga' gsol bsang dang mchod pa bzhes// dal yams rkyen kha bzlog la stong grogs mdzod// dpal ldan lha mo dpon g.yog rdzu 'phrul can// nyin gsum ri rab rtse nas bya ra mdzod// mtshan gsum stong gsum 'jig rten khyab par rgyug /de phyir bya ra ma dang rgyug byed grags// nyin gyi byar mtshan gyi mel tshe mdzod// phrin las lnga yi sprul pa'i lha mo ni// dkar mo dmar mo nag mo ser mo dang*// ljang mo la sogs bye ba 'bum phrag lnga// bdag gi mgon dang dpung du mnga' gsol lo// dus rnams rtag tu bkra shis bde legs stsol// lha mo'i yang sprul 'jig rten lha mo ni// rab brtan ma dang ma gcig dpal lha mo// a phyi mched lnga tshe ring mched lnga dang*// phag gdong mched lnga g.yu sgron mched lnga dang*// kun 'khyil mched gsum la sogs dngos grub bdag

/bdag gi nor lha mchog tu mnga' gsol lo// rma g.yang dngos grub nam mkha'i char ltar phob// lha mo'i bka' stod 'jig rten lha mo dang*// brtan ma bcu gnyis skyong ma bcu gnyis dang*// ya ma bcu gnyis mtsho sman mched dgu dang*// re re'i 'khor la sman phran 'bum phrag re// lhab lhub na bza' mang pos brgyan pa dang*// sil snyan dung dang rol mo'i sgra dang bcas// 'dir gshegs mnga' gsol bsang dang mchod pa bzhes// bdag gi yul lha mchog tu mnga' gsol lo// gzhi byes lam gsum kun du bde legs stsol// de ltar lha mo dpon g.yog 'khor bcas la// yid las byung ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho dang*// dngos 'byor dkar gsum zas phud sna tshogs dang*// 'bru mar sman sna rin chen phye mar dang*// bzang shing sna tshogs bsreg bya za ba'i lce// sbar ba'i dud sprin sngon mos nam mkha' bkang*// gsol lo mchod do lha mo 'khor bcas gsol// bsang ngo sbyang ngo nyams grib dag par mdzod// brngan no mchod do lha mo 'khor bcas brngan// bsang dang zhi ba'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la// bar chad rkyen ngan thams cad zhi ba dang*// rgyab kyi brten ma mdun gyi kha 'dzin mdzod// rtag tu bsam don sgrub pa'i stong grogs dang*// srid zhi'i dge legs 'phel zhing rgyas pa sogs// bkra shis bde legs thams cad 'phel bar mdzod// sarba de wī kā lī sa pa ri wā ra sarba pū dza khā hi/ oṃ badz+ra dhūp+pe pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pa 'di ni thog mar a rā gas mdzad pa zhig mchis par slar yang tshig gi cha shas 'ga' zhig nas/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis zhu dag gi tshul du bcos pa/ de'i dge bas gzhan phan rgya chen 'byung ba'i rgyur gyur cig /maṅga laṃ// ༄// rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras kyi bsang mchod cho ga sprin gyi rnga gsang zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// dpal ldan rgyal kun gsang bdag rdo rje 'dzin// dus 'dir ngur smrig 'chang gi tshul zhugs nas// chos kyi rgyal thabs mkhas pa'i phrin las kyis// rjes su skyong ba bla mas dge legs stsol// lus med thul gyi dbang po rin chen mang*// bkren chen 'gro ba'i dbul ba bsal slad du// mi g.yo'i sar gnas sems dpa'i sgyu 'phrul gar// rnam thos sras kyi bsang mchod cho ga 'dri// 'di'i bsang mchod la 'jug par 'dod pas// rin po che'i snod du gtor ma mkhar thabs kyi rnam pa can gyi mdun du gtso bo'i 'dzam gtor// g.yas su rta bdag brgyad la 'dzam gtor gcig

/g.yon du gnod sbyin spyi la gcig /rgyab tu klu chen spyi la gcig /mtha' skor du nor lha spyi la zan ril sum brtsegs nor bu'i dbyibs can mang pos bskor ba'am/ bsdu na dbus su gtso 'khor thun mong du 'dzam gtor che ba rgyan ldan gcig la zan ril sum brtsegs kyis bskor ba/ gzhan yang nyer spyod/ phye mar/ mda' dar/ spyan gzigs/ shing rtsi sna tshogs kyi dud pa btang*/ bsang mchod gzhan dang ma 'brel ba'i tshe sangs rgyas chos tshogs lan gsum gyis skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas la/ yo byad byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ oṃ chos rnams rang bzhin nyid kyis dag pa'i rtsal/ ma 'gags 'bru gsum yi ger shar ba las// mchod rdzas bsang rdzas 'dod yon bsam mi khyab// mchod yul yongs kyi spyan lam 'byung gyur cig /spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐ bdag nyid skad cig lag na rdo rje'i sku// sgyu ma'i rnam rol snying ga'i 'od rtse las// khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po grangs med spros// rgyal chen 'khor bcas 'gugs pa'i las byed gyur// kye chos dbyings khyab par brdal ba'i zhing khams nas// byin rlabs dngos grub mi zad 'byung ba'i gzhi// bka' babs brgyud pa'i bla ma yi dam lha// ma lus byin gyis brlab phyir gnas 'dir spyon// rin chen rdul brtsegs lhun po'i byang gi phyogs// grub pa rig 'dzin yongs kyi dga' tshal che// lcang lo can gyi rin chen pho brang sogs// gar bzhugs gnas nas rgyal chen ngal bsos po// las sgrub gnod sbyin sde dpon stobs chen dang*// gnod sbyin nor bdag dregs pa'i sde tshogs bcas// dus 'dir dam tshig dbang gis spyan 'dren na// tshur spyon tshur spyon badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ/ bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ kye mdun gyi nam mkhar rgyal ba gsang ba'i bdag /spyod mdzad chos kyi rdo rje kun tu bzang*// 'gro bzang la sogs rim brgyud bla ma dang*// rgyal ba sras bcas dbang po'i gzhu ltar bkra// de yi 'og char nor bu'i gzhal med khang*// bkod legs 'od la 'bar ba mig gi dpyid// phyogs mtshams khang brtsegs rnams dang dbang sngon khyams// khor yug kun du 'os pa'i gdan la bzhugs// gsal gdab pa ni/

kye dbus phyogs chu skyes lte bar gdong lnga pa// mi 'jigs dregs pas bsgyings pa'i gdan stengs su// sems dpa'i skyil mo krung bcas rnam thos bu// nyi shar gser gyi sa 'dzin lta bur brjid// gser sbyangs pa tra'i sgeg mo 'khyud pa'i mngal// rin chen phra tshom sbrum pa'i cod paṇa gyi// khur ldan zhal gyi dkyil 'khor rgyas pa yi// mkhur tshos mdzes pa'i snyan cha 'od du 'bar// rin chen gdub sil 'khrol ba'i phyag zung rtser// ci 'dod dbyig gi char 'bebs nor bu'i tog /rnam par bkod pa'i lhab lhub rgyal mtshan dang*// ci 'dod gter du 'jo ba'i ne'u les mtshan// rin thang dpag yas lhab lhub gos bzangs dang*// sna tshogs nor bu bstar legs chun 'phyang gis// stug por bklubs pa'i ngo mtshar la chags nas// nyi zla'i sgron ma spun dag phrag par lhags// phyogs mtshams khang brtsegs bdag po dzam+bha la// gser gyi sa 'dzin ltar brjid nor bu 'dzin// mdog bzang 'khri shing g.yo 'dra'i lag rtse na// bum pa bzang pos mdzes pa gang ba bzang*// zla gzhon khu bas byugs snyam nor bzang ni// rin chen dbang gi rgyal po phyag na bsnams// sngo bsangs mkha' yi bu mo'i lang tsho la// 'gran zlar byed pa'i lus ngan ral gri can// skyer kha'i bzhin ras ngom pa'i yang dag shes// 'od 'bar gser gyi ral gri klad la bskor// 'brog gnas mthon ka nor bu'i kha dog can// g.yo ba'i dar mdung srid pa'i rtse mor bsgreng*// lngas rtsen lag pa ser skya'i 'khri shing ni// rnam par g.yo bas rin chen khang bzang 'degs// mu tig lhun po ltar brjid 'jam po 'khyil// lag pa gri phub dag gis spras pa ste// kun kyang lha yi gos dang rin chen brgyan// lag g.yon thams cad gter gyi ne'u le 'tshir// bsam pa'i gnas kun skad cig bskor ba'i rta// cang shes rang mdog mthun pa'i steng na brjid// ngal bso'i mgon po gang de'i btsun mo sras// bang mdzod gnyer kha a pa rā dzi ta// gnod sbyin rtag mda' sring du bcas pa rnams// cha lugs mi 'dra'i ltad mo ci yang ngom// gzhan yang 'khor sa yangs pa'i khyams kun du// brtan par bcas pa'i gnod sbyin sde dpon ni// ring po mig bzang gang po ser skya dang*// seng ge nye seng dung can dga' bo dang*// seng ge seng ral bla ma ser skya dang*// 'dzin pa 'dzin dga' brtson skyong khyab 'jug dang*// lnga dpyod tshigs lnga ser po ri bo mnyam// gser can sa pa shin tu sa pa dang*// nag po nye gnag nyi zla me rlung ste// nyi shu brgyad dang gnod sbyin stobs chen ni// dbang po zla ba chu lha skye dgu'i bdag

/bha ra dh+wa dza dbang ldan tsan+da na// 'dod pa'i gtso bo mgrin ngan mgul pa nges// ba ḍi dang ni nor bu nor bu spyod// sgra rab nyer lnga ri mnyam gser can dang*// gang po seng ldeng g.yon phyogs ba lang skyong*// 'brog gnas mi rgyal rgyal ba'i khyu mchog dang*// tshigs lnga ser po bzhin bzangs ring po dang*// dri za sna tshogs sde dang 'bras bu gsum// mgul gsum pa dang lcags mdung ring po can// ma ldan nyid de sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*// gnod sbyin dbang po bye ba phrag gcig dang*// dbyig gi dpal ster klu yi dbang po brgyad// lha srin dregs pa'i 'khor gyis bskor ba ste// kun kyang lag g.yas sna tshogs mtshon cha gdengs// g.yon pa thams cad ci 'dod nor rkyal bzung*// kha dog cha lugs mtha' gcig nges min par// stug po'i chu 'dzin 'khrigs ltar gsal bar bzhugs// bsang mchod stob pa ni/ kye mchod 'os khyed rnams dgyes pa'i mthun rdzas su// yan lag brgyad ldan mchod yon chu gter 'khyil// rkang drug glu len me tog sna tshogs bkra// lhan skyes sbyar ba'i spos dris zhing khams 'gengs// mun sel sgron me'i phreng ba tshar du dngar// dri zhim nyal 'gro'i rlabs kyis mkha' la 'khyud// sna tshogs bza' bca'i zhal zas bcud du che// rnga dung rol mo'i dbyar gyi rnga gsang ldir// yid 'ong rgyan ldan gtor ma'i ri bo brtsegs// grangs med ka bas bteg pa'i pho brang ni// sgo rgyan rta babs nor bu'i 'od stong 'tsher// mu tig drwa ba dril chung glu len mkhan// mi dbang rin chen bdun dang bkra shis brgyad// gser dngul nor bu'i rigs dang ja dar gos// legs par smin pa'i 'bras gro nas sran 'bru// phyugs bdag stobs ldan glang po rta drel g.yag /'dod 'jo'i bzhon ma seng ge stag gzig sogs// spu sdug mkha' la 'gros mdzes 'dab ldan rigs// ut+pal sngon po'i mig can ri dwags rnams// ris su rtse 'jor spyod pa'i tshogs rnams 'bul// gser skyems rgya ja'i btung ba phye mar phud// sman shing bzang dgu bsregs pa'i dud sprin ni// 'dod dgu 'jo ba dpag bsam shing mtshungs kyang*// nyams grib sbyong bas khyad par 'phags pa 'dis// bla ma lha dang rgyal chen rnam thos bu// sras dang btsun mo las byed gnod sbyin brgyad// sde dpon nyer brgyad stobs chen so gnyis dang*// gnod sbyin bye ba klu dang dregs byed bcas// bsang ngo mchod do dgyes rab mchog gi 'dzum// nyi zer phog pa'i pad+ma ltar ston la// bdag cag rgyu sbyor rnams kyi nyes skyon rnams// shel gong dri ma bkrus ltar sbyang du gsol// phrin las bcol ba ni/

kye rgyal ba gsang bdag bla ma brgyud bcas kyi// bka' yis legs bsgos dam bsgrags khas blangs ltar// mdo sngags bstan pa'i nyin mtshan mgon po dag /nub med skye dgu'i bla na rtag 'char mdzod// bslab khrims chu skyes bcud kyis lus rtsal rdzogs// gzhung mang thos bsam 'dab gshog ci yang bsgyur// bshad sgrub dbyangs snyan mi zad mgrin 'jo ba// dge 'dun bung ba grangs med 'du bar mdzod// bod khams spyi dang bye brag yul gru 'dir// mi nad phyugs nad 'thab rtsod bkres rngabs dang*// btsa' then sad ser srin 'bu'i gnod pa rnams// thugs rje nus pa'i rtsal gyis zhi bar mdzod// nad med ring 'tsho'i lha bu gzhon nu dag /phan tshun mdza' gcugs bdud rtsi'i ro 'thung zhing*// lo legs 'bru bcud phun tshogs dga' tshal gyi// 'dod pa kun la longs su spyad par mdzod// bdag cag yon sbyor mi phyugs 'khor bcas la// dgra dang chom rkun gcan gzan rgyal po'i 'jigs// phyi nang 'byung gdon 'khrugs pa'i bar chad kun// nam yang mi 'byung srung ba'i gur khyim mdzod// dpag yas bsod nams gser ldan lus phra'i ltor// 'dzad med longs spyod rgya mtsho chen po 'khyil// mi 'gyur tshe yi lhun po'i phrag pa nas// phrin las nyi zla'i 'od ring 'phro bar mdzod// thos bsam sgrub pa chos kyi dpal 'byor dang*// mi nor longs spyod srid pa'i dpal 'byor sde// phan tshun phrag dog drag pos gcig la gcig /'gran zlar byed snyam rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod// legs bris gdengs can mi yul mtha' dag nas// 'khor 'das dge legs stobs 'byor phywa g.yang rnams// 'di na sprin ltar 'du zhing char ltar 'bab// bde 'byor mtsho ltar bskyil ba'i phrin las mdzod// gshags su gsol ba ni/ bsang mchod gzhan dang 'brel ba'i tshe 'dir mi dgos shing*/ ma 'brel na/ kye mchod pa'i gnas 'dir byon no cog gi mgron// rab dga' gsar pa'i chu gter 'phel ba las// yid 'ong 'dzum rlabs dkar po 'phyur bzhin du// rang rang gnas su dengs shig badz+ra muḥ// shis brjod ni/

legs pa'i lam nas legs pa'i go 'phang phyin// legs pas gzhan la legs pa'i lam gang bstan// legs par gsungs de legs phyir rtse gcig bsgrubs// legs ldan gsum gyis legs dgu'i bkra shis stsol// gzhan yang bsngo ba smon lam gang rigs brjod pa'am/ de ma shes na 'og gi tshul 'dir 'bad sogs legs byas char gyi rgyun zhes pa'i sh+lau ka gcig po 'di yar blangs la bsngo ba bya'o// smras pa/ sems can re skong mgon po rnam thos sras// 'khor dang bcas pa'i bsang mchod sprin gyi rnga// dgos 'dod char du bsnyil slad ldir ba la// skal bzang mdongs mtha' dga' ba'i gar gyis brel// srid zhi'i dpal gyi 'byung gnas yongs 'du'i shing*// ma yin rin chen mang gi sgyu 'phrul nyid// dngos grub 'gugs byed slong mo'i mu cor gtam// ma yin dgyes bskyed mchod pa'i sprin 'di'o// tshul 'dir 'bad sogs legs byas char gyi rgyun// rang gzhan sgo gsum sa bzhir bab pa las// tshogs zung dbyar gyi dga' ston dar ba'i khrod// don gnyis lhun grub snye ma g.yur za shog /ces rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras kyi bsang mchod cho ga sprin gyi rnga gsang zhes bya ba 'di ni/ bzo gnas rig pa'i gtsug lag 'dzin pa dge slong ye shes blo gros kyis snga phyir bskul ltar/ 'byung du rung ba'i yon tan la smon pa'i btags ming ngag gi dbang po 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha dbyangs can dgyes pa'i lang tsho'i sde'am/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas/ rnam byung lo'i rgyal zla'i rdzogs pa gnyis pa'i 'grub sbyor gyi nyin grub par bgyis pa'i dza yan+tu// // ༄༅// 'phags pa dzam+bha la dmar po'i bsang mchod kyi cho ga rnam par rgyal ba'i dbyangs snyan zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// dpal ldan bla ma nam mkha' mdzod la gus par phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir grwa pa mngon shes can nas brgyud pa'i dzam+bha la dmar po'i bsang mchod bya bas/

bsang rdzas rnams dang*/ gtor ma nor bu'i dbyibs can tshe ril gyis bskor bar bshams la/ 'di skad brjod do// oṃ biṃ ma la yi rin chen snod yangs su// dzaṃ yiṃ gsang gsum byin brlabs gtor ma dang*// tu ruṣ+ka sogs legs sbyar bsang mchod sprin// kun bzang rnam par thar pa'i rjes 'gror shog /kwa ye 'dod dgu char 'bebs dzam+bha la// kha dog rab dmar zhal gsum phyag drug pa// ga pur mdangs dang ser nag rmugs 'dzin tshogs// nga yi gnas 'dir dngos grub stsol phyir gshegs// ca ler bkram pa'i gdan bzhugs dzam+bha la// cha lugs rgyan bzang nor bu ne'u le las// ja dar nor bu 'jo zhing skye 'gro rnams// nya ltar dbang byed lcags kyu zhags pa 'dzin// ta thā ga ta'i yum gyur rigs byed ma// tha mas lcags zhags dang pos mda' gzhu 'gengs// da ltar khyod kyi thugs kar brtan par bzhugs// na bun 'khrigs ltar nor lhas bskor ba la// pa tra yangs par nye bar spyod pa lnga// pha gu ltar brtsegs bza' bca'i ba lin+t+raḥ// ba mo la sogs 'dod 'jo'i bzhon ma mang*// ma rmos rmos pa'i lo thog 'bru yi rigs// tsa ra lug dang ra skyes ri dwags tshogs// tsha gdung skyob pa'i grib bsil g.yo ba can// dza bo shing sogs bsregs pa'i dud sprin 'di// wa ler dmigs pa'i mgron mchog rnams la 'bul// zha nye med pa'i dngul 'dra'i 'dzum dkar ston// za chog pas mtshon rgyu sbyor 'khor bcas la// 'a 'ur dbyangs kyis 'dod don zhu ba ni// ya rabs dam pa'i spyod par bdag gnas shing*// rwa ba gangs ris bskor ba'i ljongs kun gyi// la klung skye 'gros khengs pa med btud cing*// sha ri'i bu ltar blo gros rgyas gyur nas// sa stengs bstan pa'i nyin byed 'gyur ba dang*// ha ha'i ga zha dang bcas sems can rnams// a ro ge zhes mdza' gcugs byams pas sprel/

lha'i dbang po/ /in+d+ra nyid ltar dga' bde 'byor pa'i tshogs// u da dhi mtshungs dag la spyod pa dang*// e waṃ gyis mtshan bstan pa de 'dzin dang*// o nga nam gyi sri zhur byed par bcas// phan tshun phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal rnams ni// 'gran pa bzhin du rgyas pa'i phrin las sgrubs// ces 'phags pa dzam+bha la dmar po'i bsang mchod cho ga rnam par rgyal ba'i dbyangs snyan zhes bya ba 'di'ang*/ sa dkar dbu mdzad rdo rje 'dzin pa sangs rgyas dpal ldan pa'i ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas/ gangs can pa'i brda dang mthun pa'i a phreng ka phreng gi lam nas mdor bsdus te 'phral du smras pa sarba maṅga laṃ/ skabs gzhan du bzlas pa byed na/ mdun bskyed gtso bo'i thugs ka'i rigs byed ma las/ las byed kyi mkha' 'gro ma lcags kyu zhags pa 'dzin pa'i tshogs spros/ 'jig rten khams kyi mi nor longs spyod thams cad bkug ste rang gi gnas khang yongs su gang bar bsam/ de bzhin du dzam+bha la dang ne'u le dang*/ 'og gi gnod sbyin rnams kyi zhal nas kyang gser dngul zas nor sogs ci 'dod pa skyugs nas dngos grub thob par bsams la/ sngags ni/ oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+rā ya dha na me dhi hrīḥswā hā/ zhes bzlas so// // ༄༅// rta lha'i bsang mchod kyi yi ge khu byug dga' ma myos pa'i mgrin glu zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// bi dza yan+tu/ srog chags kun la phan mdzad pa// thub pa gdung 'tshob bcas btud de// rta lha'i bsang mchod khu byug gi /dga' ma myos pa'i mgrin glu len// 'dir rta lha'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa la bsang mchod bya bar 'dod pas/ bsang rdzas mchod gtor ci 'byor pa bshams la 'di skad do// oṃ chos dbyings rtag pa'i rang bzhin 'pho min yang*// chos can rten 'brel snang ba ma 'gags mthus// mchod rdzas 'dod pa'i yon tan bsam mi khyab// mchod 'os kun gyi spyan lam 'byung gyur cig

/ces pas byin gyis brlabs/ kye gang gi thugs rje nus pa'i 'od rtse yis// reg pa'i mod la bde ster rta mchog dpal// re man+ta dang ku be ra la sogs// rta lha'i rgyal po 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs// kun gsal lus phra'i 'gram par pad+ma nyir// bla ma rta mgrin dbang gi rgyal po'i sku// byi ru'i lhun por bskal pa'i me bo ches// lan grangs brgya ru 'khyud ltar dmar la brjid// zhal gcig smin ma'i nags klung stug po'i khrod// spyan gsum nyi ma 'char ka'i 'od du 'bar// mche rnon shel gyi ral gri gzings pa'i rtser// ro 'dzin glog gi thag pa ci yang 'khyug /dur khrod chas brgyan de yi spyi bo nas// dregs pa dbang sdud rta mgo lhang lhang mtsher// dbyug to sdigs mdzub bsgrengs pa'i dpa' bo de// bgegs 'dul khro bo'i dbus su brkyang bskums bzhugs// de yi 'og char rta rnams srung ba dang*// yongs su skyob byed ār+ya re man+ta// ston zla bye ba'i lang tsho byed po yis// gcig tu spungs pas bskrun snyam mig gi dpyid// lag g.yas gang la dmigs pa de yi 'phral// gcod byed ral gri rin chen klad la bskor// g.yon pas sra ba'i gzhu dang sgro ldan mtshon// chab cig dar mdung srid pa'i rtser snyegs bzung*// lha yi gos dang rin chen rgyan mchog dang*// nyi 'od la 'khu bse yi khrab rmog gsol// myur mgyogs rlung gi spun zla'i cang shes rta// gser gyi sga srab spras pa zhabs su bcibs// mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug zung gis bla na lding*/ lcags kyi bya khra pho mo phrag gong 'phyo// stag dang seng ge'i sgeg mo gnyis gnyis kyis// snga phyir mchongs stabs sgyur ba'i lha gang dang*// rta bdag gnod sbyin dbang po ku be ra// cod paṇa snyan cha g.yo ba'i gser mdangs ni// ring du 'phro bas sgeg pa'i dpa' 'dzum bzhin// sngo bsangs nam mkha'i thigs pas bskus sam snyam// g.yas pa'i phyag gis ral gri mkhar gdengs shing*// cig shos dar mdung gter gyi bum pa bsnams// skabs gsum gnas su bskrun pa'i gos bzangs dang*// gser gyi khrab chen mdzes pa sku la gsol// sag ti'i lham gyis sba ba'i rkang pa dag

/spu sdug rma bya'i mgrin par co 'dri'i rta// bsams pa'i gnas ni skad cig bskor bzod pa// rgyan tshogs stug pos brgyan pa'i steng na rol// gnyis ka'i 'khor du mi phyugs tu raṃ ga /kun gyi dpal bskyed lha dang dgra lha dang*// lam lha 'go ba'i lha dang drang srong sogs// phan 'dogs shis pa sgrub pa'i tshogs bcas la// mchod pa'i rdzas ni spyan gzigs dkor nor sogs// yid 'ong gzugs mdzes rnams dang snyan pa'i sgra// ro drug bcud kyi bza' btung gya nom pa// lus la sim pa'i bde ster reg bya 'jam// bro nad 'joms pa'i sman dang spos kyi rigs// dri zhim rkang 'thung gzhon nu bsregs pa'i sprin// nyes tshogs sbyong la lam gsum rgyun mtshungs kyang*// ci 'dod 'jo bas khyad par 'phags pa 'dis// bsang ngo mchod do rta lha 'khor dang bcas// dgyes rab rtse mor phyin pa'i 'dzum dkar gyis// rtag tu bran pas bdag cag yon sbyor rnams// mi mthun phyogs las rnam par rgyal bar mdzod// khyad par rngog chags theg pa kun gyi nad// rngo dang 'bras lhog glo dang 'tsher langs lhad// tsha dang grang dug grum 'theng mgo 'thoms rnams// zhi zhing slad du mi 'byung srung ba mdzod// gnam 'phyo'i grong khyer bsrubs las skyes pa'i rta// cang shes 'thor thos grags pa 'gog bzod pa'i// tshe dang lang tsho lus kyi shugs bdo zhing*// ci 'dod gom stabs mkhas pa'i dngos grub stsol// dgra dang chom rkun gcan gzan gdon bgegs sogs// gdug sems tsher ma gang du gzings pa dag /mthu stobs mchog gi zhugs lce glal ba'i khar// ma lus thal bar bsregs pa'i phrin las mdzod// mchod yul mgron du gnyer byas thams cad ni// dga' ba'i 'dzum zer ngom pa bzhin du bdag /yon sbyor 'khor dang bzhon pa bcas kun dang*// mnyam du 'grogs nas kha 'dzin stong grogs mdzod// tshe dpal 'byor pa pu lo ma dgra yi// bsod nams dum bu ma nyams sa stengs 'dir// 'phos pa min nam snyam par bkra shis pa'i// dbyangs snyan rgyal ba kun gyis sgrogs shig kye// de ltar rta lha'i bsang mchod kyi yi ge khu byug dga' ma myos pa'i mgrin glu zhes bya ba 'di ni/

sa'i steng gi mi'i dbang phyug chen po sde dge bsod nams mgon po nas/ chibs gsor gnang ba'i skabs gtsug lag lugs brgya'i phrin las kyi kha lo sgyur ba/ dge bshes bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa'i bka' lung gis bskul ltar/ snyan dngags smra ba'i ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig /maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅// klu'i bsang mchod kyi cho ga gdengs can rol pa'i chu gter zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// dpag yas thugs rje'i sprin las dngos grub char// rgyun du che bas dge legs lo thog dag /smin mdzad bla ma klu dbang la btud de// bsang mchod gdengs can rol pa'i chu gter bskrun// 'di'i bsang mchod la/ rang nyid gtsang sbra dang ldan pas klu gnas pa'i chu mig gi 'gram la sogs par/ klu sman bzang po dang dkar mngar gyis sbags pa'i nyer spyod rnams dang*/ mthun pa'i spos dang shing rtsi'i dud pa btang ba la chu gtsang gis bran/ 'dir ja chang phye gsur sogs gzhob kyi rigs ni mi bya'o// de nas mchod pa rnams/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs pa rnams su/ oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i nye bar spyod pa rnams dang bsang rdzas mchod pa'i yo byad rnams kyis nam mkha'i khams gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da rol mo bcas pas byin gyis brlabs la/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs lan gsum gyis skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya/ swa bhā was stong par bsgom/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i steng du/ hrīḥlas bdag nyid spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug sku mdog dkar po/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon pad+ma bsnams pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o// rang gi mdun du rin po che'i brag ri gser gyi bya skyibs can gyi drung na/ mkha' ltar sngo ba'i mchod pa rdzing bu dang*/

'bab chu lhung lhung gi sgra 'byin pa/ g.yu'i kha dog can gyi ne'u gsing dang*/ skyed mos tshal dang*/ rin po che'i ljon shing*/ me tog dang lo 'dab gsar pa'i lding khang du grib bsil yid du 'ong ba 'jo ba/ 'dod pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs pas gtams shing*/ nor bu chu shel gyi pho brang nyams dga' bar byas pa'i gnas su/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du nāṃ dgu las/ dbus dang phyogs mtshams rnams su rim par wa ru ṇa dkar po/ mtha' yas dkar po/ 'jog po dmar po/ stobs kyi rgyu nag po/ rigs ldan dkar po/ nor rgyas ser po/ dung skyong ser po/ pad+ma dkar po/ chu lha dkar po rnams stod lha'i lus can thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du nor bu rin po che thogs pa/ smad sbrul mjug 'khyil pa/ sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka can/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ g.yon phyogs nas rang dang 'dra ba'i chung mas bsten pa'o// rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas 'dod pa'i khams na gnas pa'i klu'i rgyal po rnams kyis gtsor byas pa'i klu dang sa bdag thams cad oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ting shag dang*/ ri rab rtse nas rgya mtsho'i gting mthar thug /'dzam gling yul gru kun du rab gnas pa'i// bstan la rab dga'i klu chen brgyad kyis mtshon// klu dang sa bdag rigs gyur ma lus pa// de ring mchod pa'i slad du spyan 'dren na// lag na rdo rje'i mthu stobs dam tshig dang*// spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje byin rlabs kyis// thogs pa med par gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi/ zhes dang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥpad+ma ka ma la ya s+t+waṃ/ de nas bsang mchod stob pa ni/ oṃ dkon mchog yon tan gter gyi byin rlabs dang*// rgyu 'bras mi bslu nges pa'i bden stobs kyis// bsang rdzas mchod sprin nam mkha' khengs pa 'di// gdengs can yongs kyi nyer 'tsho mchog gyur cig

/kye rgya chen sbyin pa'i 'bras bu legs smin pas// 'dzad med 'byor pa phun tshogs gter gyi bdag /klu chen brgyad po klu rigs grangs med bcas// dga' bskyed bsang dang mchod sprin 'bul ba ni// 'o chab sman gyi mchod yon rdzing bur bskyil// thang chur skyes pa'i me tog ut+pal bzhad// dri zhim spos mchog sā la'i ngad pa ldang*// mkhan shug sur dkar sba snyug stag pa sogs// dbyar skyes rkang 'thung mthun rdzas ji snyed dag /gtul ba'i dud sprin 'dod yon lnga 'jo zhing*// nyams grib nyes tshogs sbyong ba'i bsang mchod dang*// zhun mar nor bu'i sgron mes mun pa 'joms// rgya mtsho lbu ba rdo rgyus zho sha gsum// chu srin sder mo dbang lag pu shel tse// sbrul shun rma bya'i mdongs sogs 'o chab dang*// mnyam 'dres btung ba byug pa'i rgya mtsho che// dkar gsum mngar gsum 'khur ba shing thog rigs// ro bcud nus gter zhal zas phye mar dang*// sgra brnyan rol mo snyan pa'i glur 'jo zhing*// dpag yas nor bu'i rgyan phreng dar zab gos// ci 'dod gter gyi bum pa bzang po sogs// legs bris mi yul nyer spyad mkho dgu yis// mchod do klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas la mchod// bsang ngo nyes skyon nyams grib phog pa bsang*// so so'i dbang po lnga yi ngang dur dag /'dod pa'i yon tan mi zad rgya mtsho'i klong*// ci dgar longs su spyad pa'i bde skyid kyis// kun nas myos pa'i dbyangs snyan len gyur cig /sa chu rdo shing gnyen po gang dag tu// thub chod rtsom pas klu dang sa bdag rigs// snad pa'i nad dang sdug bsngal kun sos nas// lha lus ltar mdzes bde dang ldan gyur cig /bdag cag rgyu sbyor mi dang phyugs bcas la// klu gdon las gyur nad gdon bar chad dang*// chur gtad sa la mnan sogs gnod pa las// sprin bral zla ba lta bur grol bar mdzod// bsod nams mtho ris dga' tshal yangs pa'i nang*// tshe yi ljon shing ring por bskyed pa las// mi nor longs spyod srid pa'i phun tshogs kyi// lo 'dab chos rnams thams cad rgyu las byung zhes sogs nas/ 'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skye// rin chen chos bshad dge bas gdengs can rnams// gnod pa kun bral slad mar bde 'gror skyes// dkon mchog dam pa'i chos kyi snod gyur nas// thams cad gzigs pa thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig /bzod par gsol zhing gshegs su gsol ba ni// dgyes skyed mchod pa'i gnas 'dir byon pa'i klu// dgyes min ma 'byor nyams sogs bzod mdzad de// dgyes pa'i drin lan blan 'dod shing rta la// dgyes par zhon nas rang rang gnas su dengs// zhes dang*/ slar yang 'gror ma 'dod pa'i gdug pa can rnams/ muḥzhes bskrad cing bya khyung gi phyag rgya dang*/ ga ru ḍa tsa le tsa le swā hās bsrungs la/ bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad gang rigs brjod do// klu rnams mchod pa'i cho ga 'di bgyis pa'i// dge bas sbyin bzhi'i pha rol legs phyin nas// don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i phrin las kyis// srid gsum sdug bsngal mtsho las 'don par shog /ces klu'i bsang mchod kyi cho ga gdengs can rol pa'i chu gter zhes bya ba 'di ni/ don gnyer dge slong byams pa bkra shis kyis bskul ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis rga lo'i lugs kyi klu gtor dang klu bsang gi brjod bya'i snying po bsdus te/ nyams su blang bder bris pa bkra shis par gyur cig/ // ༄༅// zhing lha chen po 'khor bcas dbu 'phang bstod cing mchod pa'i cho ga rdzogs ldan sprin phung zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// swasti bi dza yan+tu/ dpag yas thugs bskyed smon lam rmad byung gis// gangs can 'gro la ci 'dod dga' ston mkhan// bla ma spyan ras gzigs dbang gtsug bsten nas// zhing lha bstod cing mchod pa'i cho ga brtsam// de la zhing lha'i rten rdo dkar gsum mar gyis brgyan pa btsugs/ shing rtsi bal tshon gyis brgyan pa dang*/ rin po che/ dar tshon/

gang ba dang*/ gzhan yang rten dang spyan gzigs/ dkor nor bsang rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa mgron rnams kyi dbang po lnga'i spyod yul du 'dod pa'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung bar gyur par bsams la/ sngags drug dang phyag rgya drug gis byin gyis brlab cing spel/ de nas/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis sa lha zhing lha klu gnyan 'khor dang bcas pa spyan 'dren par bsams la/ hrīḥdapal 'byor 'dod dgu'i dga' ston 'byung ba'i gzhi// sa lha brtan ma zhing lha tshangs pa che// klu rigs lnga dang gnyan chen sde bzhir bcas// 'di na 'bod do rings par tshur gshegs shig /bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ kye sems rgyud rang bzhin gshin pa'i zhing sa la// bsod nams sa bon rma med btab las skyes// rdzu 'phrul mthu stobs snye ma g.yur za ba// srid pa'i lha rnams rten 'dir brtan par bzhugs// dngos gzhi dpangs bstod cing mchod pa stob pa ni/ kye dang por zhing lha bstod pa gang du srid// gangs can ljongs kyi khor yug yangs par sngon// thub mchog bstan pa'i snang byed ma shar bar// mi min gyis bzung mtha' 'khob mun 'thibs tshe// bsil ldan 'gro ba 'dul bar dam bca'i rta// smon lam mi dman kha lo legs bsgyur ba// spyan ras gzigs sprul yal ga'i ri dwags gzugs// ha lu mañdzu zhes bya 'phags pa las// dge bsnyen sdom pa'i bslab gzhi legs mnos te// gangs can brag la bsam gtan bsgom gyin gnas// gang tshe sgrol ma'i sgyu 'phrul brag srin mo// spre'u'i gzugs bzung rnam 'phrul du ma yis// dge bsnyen 'phyon 'drid brtsams par 'phags pa yi// zhal nas bza' tshor btub pa'i bka' stsal mnos// nam zhig 'gro ba drug nas mngon 'phos pa'i// shes rgyud tha dad sprel phrug drug btsas pa// lho phyogs nags su bskyal ba ring zhig nas// mi min sprel min bu tsha mang 'phel ba// bkres pas zas gos slong ba'i rnam pa can// de mthong 'gyod cing 'phags pa'i spyan sngar phyin// khyim thab sdig pa'i rgyur song ma rangs par// 'phags pa'i zhal nas 'di ni ches legs te// de las mi yi rgyud 'phel bdag cag gis// gdul bya dam pa'i chos kyi snod 'gyur zhes// phyogs der rin chen rnam lnga'i phye mas gtor// nas gro sran sogs 'bru rigs bdun stsal nas// mi'u rigs drug nor dang zas skal du// legs par smin 'gyur smon lam lung bstan stsal// dge bsnyen de thos phyir 'ong dpyid kyi dpal// dar babs dus su zhing lha gnyen po dag

/lo legs grogs su bsgos nas rang nyid kyi// dge ba'i smon lam lhan cig sa bon btab// ston dus lo thog legs smin 'bru yi tshogs// skye 'gro'i nyer tsho rgyun chad med par dar// yang cig zhing lha gsol
